Sandbox_VZS_Enable_tooltip: Master switch. When off, this mod never touches the Zombie Lore Speed or Toughness settings and vanilla behaviour applies.
Sandbox_VZS_SeasonMode_tooltip: Single profile: always use the Default Profile page. \nPer-season profiles: use the Spring / Summer / Autumn / Winter page matching the current in-game season, falling back to the Default Profile outside the four seasons.
Sandbox_VZS_TimeMode_tooltip: Fixed hours: use each profile's Night Start / Night End hours. \nGame dusk/dawn: ignore those hours and follow the season's own dusk and dawn, like the vanilla "Day/Night Zombie Speed Effect" option.
Sandbox_VZS_ForceActiveOnly_tooltip: Forces Zombie Lore > "Day/Night Zombie Speed Effect" to "Both" so the vanilla dusk/dawn slowdown does not fight this mod. \nTurn off only if you want both systems stacked.
Sandbox_VZS_RefreshOnSwitch_tooltip: At each switchover, walk the loaded zombie list and re-apply the new speed to every zombie. \nRequired for night to day: already-sprinting zombies keep sprinting otherwise.
Sandbox_VZS_RefreshBatch_tooltip: How many zombies to update per game tick during a switchover. \nLower this if you see a stutter at dusk/dawn on a high-population world.
Sandbox_VZS_SweepEnable_tooltip: Continuously checks loaded zombies and fixes any whose speed does not match the current phase. \nCatches zombies that stream in from unloaded chunks. \nSkipped when the current phase speed is "Random".
Sandbox_VZS_SweepInterval_tooltip: Run one sweep batch every N game ticks.
Sandbox_VZS_SweepBatch_tooltip: How many zombies each sweep batch inspects.
Sandbox_VZS_SyncInterval_tooltip: Multiplayer only. How often the server re-sends the current zombie speed state to clients, in REAL seconds. \nA dusk or dawn change is pushed immediately regardless; this is the safety net that recovers a client which missed it, reconnected, or had its settings changed behind the server's back. \nThe payload is a handful of numbers, so 1 second costs a few KB/s even on a full server. Raise it only if you are chasing bandwidth.
Sandbox_VZS_Notify: Survivor comments at dusk and dawn
Sandbox_VZS_Notify_tooltip: Your character mutters an in-character line when the night window opens or closes, and when the season turns. \nLines vary by season, by whether you are outdoors, and are darker when the coming night is a Sprinter night. \nThis is speech-bubble text only - it makes no noise and does not attract zombies.
Sandbox_VZS_Debug_tooltip: Verbose logging to console.txt, plus an on-screen readout of the current season, phase, target speed, XP multiplier and live zombie speed counts.
Sandbox_VZS_XpEnable_tooltip: Multiplies XP earned *from fighting* during the night window by the active profile's Night XP Multiplier. \nOnly XP gained within a short window after hitting a zombie is boosted, so night-time exercise, reading and crafting are unaffected.
Sandbox_VZS_XpCombatSkills_tooltip: Axe, Blunt, Small Blunt, Long Blade, Small Blade, Spear, Maintenance, Aiming and Reloading.
Sandbox_VZS_XpStrength_tooltip: Boost Strength XP earned from fighting at night.
Sandbox_VZS_XpFitness_tooltip: Boost Fitness XP earned from fighting at night.
Sandbox_VZS_XpWindow_tooltip: How long after hitting a zombie XP still counts as combat XP. \nRaise this if kill XP is being missed; lower it if unrelated XP is being boosted.
Sandbox_VZS_NightStart_tooltip: In-game hour when zombies switch to their night speed in Default. 24-hour clock, fractions allowed (19.5 = 19:30). \nOnly used with "Fixed hours" timing.
Sandbox_VZS_NightEnd_tooltip: In-game hour when zombies switch back to their day speed in Default. \nMay be earlier than Night Start; the window wraps over midnight. \nOnly used with "Fixed hours" timing.
Sandbox_VZS_NightSpeed_tooltip: Zombie speed inside the Default night window.
Sandbox_VZS_DaySpeed_tooltip: Zombie speed outside the Default night window.
Sandbox_VZS_NightToughness_tooltip: Zombie Lore > Toughness used inside the night window. Tough zombies are harder to kill (-6 crit chance), Fragile easier (+6). \n"Leave unchanged" restores whatever Toughness the world was created with.
Sandbox_VZS_DayToughness_tooltip: Zombie Lore > Toughness used outside the night window.
Sandbox_VZS_NightXp_tooltip: Multiplier applied to XP earned from fighting during the Default night window. 1.0 disables the bonus.
Sandbox_VZS_SpringNightStart_tooltip: In-game hour when zombies switch to their night speed in Spring. 24-hour clock, fractions allowed (19.5 = 19:30). \nOnly used with "Fixed hours" timing.
